driver.title: USB driver
driver.prompt:
Windows needs the WinUSB driver to work with the Switch. Install it now?

Windows will ask for administrator permission. The driver is built into Windows and signed by Microsoft.
driver.done: The driver is installed. If the Switch is not detected within a few seconds, reconnect the cable.
driver.reboot: The driver is installed. Restart Windows to finish the installation.
driver.not_connected: Connect the Switch and open DBI → Install title from USB, then try again.
